detail:
New: src/retrieval/{select,lifecycle,tokenizer,packet,render,receipts,explain,store-identity,index}.ts. Modified: src/engine/context-assembler.ts, src/engine/decisions.ts (why read path), src/core/commands/context.ts, src/dashboard/query-routes.ts. Tests: test/retrieval/{select,tokenizer-packet,render-receipts,recall-measurement,dashboard-scope}.test.ts and test/acceptance/cases/{c01-c05,c08,c12,c19,c25,c26}.test.ts + harness.ts + README.md. Harness: scripts/calibrate-tokenizer.mjs + test/fixtures/tokenizer-corpus/.

CENTRAL DESIGN POINT: read visibility is a THIRD scope operation. scopeMatches is bidirectional so it would admit records a principal may not read; scopeGoverns carries a revision clause that would make a read entitlement evaporate the moment HEAD moved. select.ts defines scopeAuthorizes(envelope, record): identity-exact plus pathCovers, no revision clause. Proposed contract diff: export it from src/contracts/scope.ts alongside the existing two.

Selection = authorization (hard, denials opaque) INTERSECT query relevance (denials reportable). The split is load-bearing: scope_denied members must never be named to the requester, out_of_query_scope members safely can.

Lifecycle states are READ from src/events/projection.ts, never recomputed. One addition: retrieval refuses action qualification on a conflicted record even when the reducer's authorizes_action says the class is high enough - two authorized statements disagree and retrieval declines to pick.
summary: Lane 04 built: scope-first gate (src/retrieval/select.ts) applied before all ranking; gaps 3/6/7 flipped with controls green; 2096 tests pass, tsc clean
